caption: The drawing features a detailed colored illustration of a long-sleeved, deep-purple or burgundy cropped jacket with a low neckline, decorated with small pink, green, and light blue floral embroidery distributed along the sleeves and the front. The jacket has elaborate trim or pleating along the neckline and edges in a matching dark color. The front view of the jacket is shown in full color, while above and to the right there is a back view of the same jacket rendered in a light pencil sketch, displaying the seam lines and a ruffled or pleated trim around the back neckline. The drawing uses a plain off-white or beige background, and both views of the garment are presented on an unembellished mannequin outline with no facial or bodily details.
title: Spencer
